rachel (eng-sre): PM posted: INC-1832. Root cause: KV eviction cascade + delayed autoscaler. Need quick runbook edits and owners.

rachel (eng-sre): Short action list: 1) KV triage block (owner: mohan, due: 2025-05-14). 2) Containment 'safe-mode' commands + diagnostic snippet (owner: leo, due: 2025-05-16). 3) Explicit autoscaler-failure escalation ladder (owner: kai, due: 2025-05-13). 4) Tag recurring-pattern and add 30d review (owner: rachel, due: 2025-05-21).

mohan (eng-platform): I'll add KV checks: hit ratio, eviction rate, TTL skew, and a one-click fallback toggle.

leo (eng-runtime): Taking safe-mode. Draft snippet for runbook:

```
# safe-mode: limit concurrency + readonly cache
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-api --replicas=1
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-api KV_CACHE_MODE=readonly
python -m redwood.tools.kv_dump --recent-evictions=25
```

leo (eng-runtime): Will include example outputs and grep hints.

kai (infra): For escalation ladder propose: @oncall-sre -> @platform-pager if no ack in 5m -> page infra lead after 15m -> exec manager after 30m. I'll add rotation links.

runbook-bot: Draft runbook created by mohan: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-1832-draft PR #498.

mohan (eng-platform): PR has checklist and sample queries. Scheduling 20m walkthrough 2025-05-12 14:00 UTC.

rachel (eng-sre): Thanks—keep runbook focused on triage/containment. I'll open Optimize ticket for fallback variants.

runbook-bot: Reminder set: walkthru 2025-05-12 14:00 UTC.

mohan (eng-platform): After walkthrough I'll merge and tag runbook with postmortem link and recurring-pattern.
